== Decipher replacement-text authority and date ==
The complete replacement wording for [[Dark Jedi Lightsaber (Errata)|Dark Jedi Lightsaber]] appears in Decipher’s November 1998 Star Wars CCG Glossary, Version 2.0, PDF page 45. The later Players Committee Appendix A reproduces this wording. Released uses the Decipher documentary bound. The Holotable illustration is a separate source copy; its image date is not this text state’s publication date. The printed Title property, publisher and Errata label follow the primary authority; the GEMP identifier, complete game text, Lore, statistics and images are preserved. [http://decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Primary document]. Recovered full document: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0 (PDF)]].

The former Light.json citation pointed at the other side’s dataset. It is corrected to the same commit’s complete Dark.json, which supports this card’s auxiliary metadata. The replacement wording and its date are verified separately against Decipher’s Glossary.
